title: French Poppy Seed Pilaf
description: A flavorful pilaf dish inspired by French cuisine, featuring poppy seeds and a variety of ingredients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the pilaf rice and sauté for 2-3 minutes until lightly toasted.
Add the vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.
Stir in the poppy seeds and raisins.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until the flavors are combined.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
